# AMC Flip Tiles

<!-- Generated by tools/build-templates.mjs from template.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**List Template** for Universal Theme · direction: depth · APEX 23.1+ · v1.0.1

Launch tiles that turn over in 3D on hover and keyboard focus: icon and label on the front, a description and a call to action on a colored back face, while each tile stays one real link.

**Use it for:** Launchpads and module menus with 3 to 16 entries where a destination needs one or two lines of explanation, such as self-service portals and onboarding hubs.

## Install

- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, through the Builder):** App Builder > your app > Shared Components >
  Export/Import > Import `dist/legacy/amc_tpl_flip_tiles.sql` (Component Export). It creates the
  template in Universal Theme and its Static Application File(s) in `amc-templates/`.
- **APEX 26.1+ (APEXlang):** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/themes/universal-theme/list-templates/amc-flip-tiles.apx` and
  `dist/apexlang/shared-components/static-files/amc-templates/` into the app, add the entries from
  `dist/apexlang/static-files.snippet.apx` to `shared-components/static-files.apx`, then run the apexlang gates.

## Use

Create or pick a List (Shared Components > Lists), add a **List** region and set **Appearance > List Template** to **AMC Flip Tiles**. In APEXlang: `componentAppearance { listTemplate: @amc-flip-tiles }`.

List template for a List region. Front: the entry icon and text. Back: User Defined Attribute 1 as the description and Attribute 2 as the call-to-action text, for example 'Request leave'; when Attribute 2 is empty only an arrow is shown. Tiles turn over on hover and on keyboard focus; each tile is a single link, so Tab moves through the tiles in list order and Enter opens the destination. The current entry has a filled front. On touch screens and under reduced motion both faces are shown together as one tile, so nothing is hover-only and nothing moves. Template options: Flip vertically, Compact, Palette, Ink.

## List entry attributes

| Attribute | Meaning |
|---|---|
| A01 | Description |
| A02 | Call to action |

## Template options

| Option | Class | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Flip vertically | `amc-TFlipTiles--flipX` | Tiles turn over top to bottom instead of sideways. |
| Compact | `amc-TFlipTiles--compact` | Smaller tiles of 138px, for side columns and dense menus. |
| Palette | `amc-TFlipTiles--palette` | Each tile takes a hue derived from the theme's primary color. Browsers without relative color syntax keep the primary color. |
| Ink | `amc-TFlipTiles--ink` | Neo-brutal look: ink borders in the theme text color, flat fills and hard offset shadows. |
